bio: Located in the vibrant area of Renfield Street, Cup Tea Lounge is a tea room with a vintage touch. Enjoy a classic Afternoon Tea on vintage china, and enjoy the spectacular Victorian decor.  Cup Tea Lounge offers a delicious Afternoon Tea including a selection of savoury bites, warm scones and an array of sweet treats. Why not upgrade your Afternoon Tea with a glass of prosecco, champagne or gin and tonic? Gluten Free and Vegetarian menus are also available.  Afternoon Tea is served in the main restaurant area, featuring high ceilings and vintage tiling.  Cup Tea Lounge- Glasgow Renfield Street is located in Glasgow city centre and is within walking distance of Glasgow Central Station and Glasgow Queen Street Station.
